description: Source code implementing ASN.1 message structures and methods for 3GPP NR RRC paging messages, including packing, unpacking, JSON serialization, and handling of various paging message types and identifiers.

classes.name: group_paging_r18_s
classes.description: Represents the GroupPaging-r18 ASN.1 sequence with a boolean flag for inactive reception.

classes.name: paging_ue_id_c
classes.description: Represents the PagingUE-Identity ASN.1 CHOICE with methods to set, get, serialize, and destroy different identifier types.

classes.name: paging_record_s
classes.description: Represents a paging record with UE identity and access type.

classes.name: paging_record_v1700_s
classes.description: Represents a paging record for version 1700 with paging cause.

classes.name: paging_record_v1800_s
classes.description: Represents a paging record for version 1800 with MT-SDT flag.

classes.name: paging_v1800_ies_s
classes.description: ASN.1 sequence for paging information elements in version 1800, including lists of records and extensions.

classes.name: paging_v1700_ies_s
classes.description: ASN.1 sequence for paging information elements in version 1700, including lists of records and extensions.

classes.name: paging_s
classes.description: Main ASN.1 sequence for paging message, including record lists and extensions.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into a bit_ref buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a bit_ref buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the object into JSON format.

methods.name: destroy_
methods.description: Destroys the current choice in the paging_ue_id_c class.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the identifier type and initializes the corresponding data.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying paging_ue_id_c objects.

methods.name: set_full_i_rnti
methods.description: Sets the identifier to full I-RNTI.
